Name: Micah, Son of Shimei
Summary: Son of Shimei and father of Reaia in Reuben's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:5: Son of Shimei and father of Reaia in Reuben's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Micah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
